# agenco_tool (Resource)

Manages the mutable settings of an existing tool — typically one produced by agenco_tools_import or an MCP proxy source. The API exposes no create route for individual tools, so this resource adopts a tool by ID rather than creating it, and destroying the resource deletes the tool. Use the agenco_tools data source to discover tool IDs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "agenco_tools" "orders" {
  application_id = agenco_application.storefront.id
  source_id      = agenco_mcp_source.orders_api.id
}

locals {
  refund_tool_id = one([
    for tool in data.agenco_tools.orders.tools : tool.id if tool.name == "createRefund"
  ])
}

# Tighten a single imported tool without touching the rest of the import.
resource "agenco_tool" "refund" {
  id             = local.refund_tool_id
  application_id = agenco_application.storefront.id

  description         = "Issues a refund against a settled order"
  authentication_type = "Authenticated"
  is_active           = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Application the tool belongs to.
- `id` (String) ID of the tool to manage. Immutable.

### Optional

- `authentication_type` (String) Authentication mode. One of: [Authenticated Unauthenticated].
- `description` (String) Tool description exposed to agents.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the tool is exposed through the gateway.
- `name` (String) Tool name exposed to agents.
- `original_method` (String) HTTP method of the upstream operation the tool calls.
- `original_path` (String) Path of the upstream operation the tool calls.
- `output_schema` (String) JSON Schema object describing the tool output, encoded as a JSON string.
- `source_id` (String) Source the tool is attached to. Set it to move the tool between sources.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import agenco_tool.refund 0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789/99998888-7777-6666-5555-444433332222
```
